shared_or_similar_visual_information: A line or boundary made of separated short strokes.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It represents a hidden rear edge of the rectangular prism. Right image: It is the vertical asymptote used as a reference for the plotted function.
Rationales: The left dashes convey occlusion in a three-dimensional wireframe. The right broken vertical reference is an asymptote beside a function curve, with no solid to supply an occluded edge. The two stroke styles therefore encode different contextual functions.
